$description: IKIGAI ATLAS design token manifest. The group files listed here are the single source of truth. Run `npm run tokens:build` to regenerate the SCSS custom properties, the Sass breakpoint map and the TypeScript constants; CI runs `npm run tokens:check` to reject hand edits or stale output.
name: ikigai-atlas
format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft ($value / $type / $description); `{group.token}` references; `DEFAULT` keys collapse into the parent name.

lifeDimensions.$description: Canonical Life Dimension order and keys. Lower-case keys are used for tokens/CSS; the backend/API key is the upper-case form (CAREER, FINANCE, …). Keys never change; labels are display defaults.

icons.$description: Tabler outline icon names (see atlas ADR-0005).
